_comment: Desired Cloud Scheduler jobs, reconciled on every deploy by scripts/scheduler_reconcile.py. Each job is created as lemely-<environment>-<id>. Adding an entry creates it, editing one updates it, and removing or renaming one deletes the old job, but only jobs carrying the lemely-deploy ownership marker are ever deleted. `secret` names a GitHub secret (per environment); the deploy step must also map it into its env. An empty secret skips that job with a warning and never deletes it. See docs/ci-cd.md.
